111:t_1:89.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$フロンタル$$'s lapdog... Playing the overseer...」

111:t_1:90.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Thank you, $$ギュネイ$$. That was a big help.」

111:t_1:91.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't be so familiar. I'm a $$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldier now.」

111:t_1:92.en:
$$チェーン$$
「...What are you so irritated about?」

111:t_1:94.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Don't you disapprove of the way $$ネオ・ジオン$$ does things these days...?」

111:t_1:95.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up...! Now that the Federation has been weakened, the time has come for the Spacenoids' long-cherished wish to be fulfilled!」

111:t_1:96.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm $$ネオ・ジオン$$...! I'll just fight for the people of space!」

111:t_1:100.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Leader only told me to take this base and secure the $$ガンダム$$. Everything after that, I decide at my own discretion.」

111:t_1:101.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(That's right... To surpass that man, I have to defeat the $$ガンダム$$ with my own hands...)

111:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm glad you're safe, $$チェーン$$.」

111:t_2:7.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Its maintenance is finished. On $$ギュネイ$$'s orders, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ hasn't laid so much as a finger on it.」

111:t_2:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's still hope... In this battle, and in $$ネオ・ジオン$$, too...!」

111:t_3:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...I'm glad to see you understand.」

111:t_3:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「《$$クロノ$$》, your existing collaborator, is already losing its power.」

111:t_3:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As proof, $$ネオ・ジオン$$, your new collaborator, will arrive at $$クロノ$$'s doctrine on its own and show it to you.」

111:t_3:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood. I'll report this matter to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

111:t_3:9.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I'll see what you can do.」

111:t_3:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... So it does become a power that changes the world, after all.」

111:t_3:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$... How do things stand on Earth?」

111:t_3:13.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Due to $$ギュネイ・ガス$$'s blunder, $c has retaken $$ピーターソン基地$$.」

111:t_3:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then that $$ガンダム$$ is...」

111:t_3:15.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「It has passed into $$アムロ・レイ$$'s hands.」

111:t_3:17.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Did you foresee this outcome?」

111:t_3:18.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I merely took it that neither way would be a problem. If the $$ガンダム$$ fell into $$アムロ・レイ$$'s hands, I would question $$ギュネイ$$'s ability as a commander...」

111:t_3:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And if he managed to hold on to the $$ガンダム$$ and the base, that would be welcome in its own way.」

111:t_3:20.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That man doesn't seem to understand who the current Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is.」

111:t_3:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It hasn't been long since I took the Leader's seat. It can't be helped.」

111:t_3:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But the $$シャア・アズナブル$$ faction, him included, is also an important force for $$ネオ・ジオン$$. Even if it takes time, we need to make them understand.」

111:t_3:23.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Then $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ will...」

111:t_3:24.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's no need to cast him aside over one failure. He'll work for us as well.」

111:t_3:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「From now on, we will drive out the $$連邦軍$$ in North America while pursuing the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.」

111:t_3:26.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「For $$ラプラスの箱$$, then...」

111:t_3:27.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes. The $$時獄戦役$$ revealed the next coordinates after Dakar, but $$バナージ$$ doesn't seem to have any intention of going there.」

111:t_3:28.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then we have no choice but to carry the Box's key to that place with our own hands.」

111:t_3:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(That's how it is, $$バナージ$$. I'm sorry, but time is running out for us as well...)

111:t_3:30.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(At this rate, humanity on Earth will perish... To preserve the human species, I will exhaust every means...)

111:t_3:37.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Looks like a lot of the members are in shock.」

111:t_3:38.en:
$$マリー$$
「It's only natural. We expected it from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, but to think that part of the $$連邦軍$$, even if only a part, was cooperating with the Empire...」

111:t_3:39.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So it was no coincidence at all that $$ピーターソン基地$$ fell so easily, or that the $$ジオン$$ came to the base where the $$νガンダム$$ was.」

111:t_3:40.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It was all the work of traitors within the $$連邦軍$$, then.」

111:t_3:41.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「According to Warrant Officer $$チェーン$$, even having the $$νガンダム$$ brought here was a scheme by the pro-$$サイデリアル$$ faction within the $$連邦軍$$.」

111:t_3:42.en:
$$刹那$$
「And then they invited in $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and handed over the base with only a token resistance...」

111:t_3:43.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Are you saying they gave up on the $$連邦軍$$ because the Federation was about to lose to the Empire!?」

111:t_3:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They are probably... units with $$クロノ$$'s hand in them.」

111:t_3:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$クロノ$$ was a collaborator of the $$ジェミニス$$... Which means they're connected to the $$サイデリアル$$ too.」

111:t_3:48.en:
$n
「If we had crushed those guys in the $$時獄戦役$$, it wouldn't have come to this...」

111:t_3:49.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If the fighting goes on like this...」

111:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クロノ$$ will tear the $$連邦軍$$ to shreds from the inside, and they will lose control entirely.」

111:t_3:52.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$連邦軍$$' defeat will probably be inevitable.」

111:t_3:53.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The remaining units in each region will keep fighting, but it will become difficult to turn around a war that has already tilted. Above all, people's spirits will break before that...」

111:t_3:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If things go badly, those who keep resisting the $$サイデリアル$$ may become a minority within humanity...」

111:t_3:55.en:
$$刹那$$
「But what you get by surrendering to the Empire like that is a false peace.」

111:t_3:56.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. The future we tried to win by destroying the $$時の牢獄$$ is nothing like that.」

111:t_3:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I... still believe hope remains.」

111:t_3:59.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even while he's in $$ネオ・ジオン$$, he's been growing more and more irritated with the way $$ネオ・ジオン$$ does things.」

111:t_3:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He can't be the only one who thinks that way.」

111:t_3:61.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think so, too. In the $$時獄戦役$$, humanity gave its answer: that we overcome hardship and seek the future.」

111:t_3:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you understand that, that's good.」

111:t_3:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Given that, you know what we have to do, right?」

111:t_3:64.en:
$n
「To keep fighting... By doing so, we become a hope for the people fighting the Empire.」

ピーターソン基地.evidence: Not in the glossary sheet. Federation base in North America where the Nu Gundam was stored; English is the literal reading of the Japanese (a place named Peterson).
